# Akira Ishi

> Akira Ishi is an anonymous generative artist based in France. They write code to map what it is to be human: one work, multiple facets, all linked by a hidden story. The work is mostly inscribed fully on-chain on Bitcoin Ordinals, and also exists on Ethereum, Base and Polkadot. This site is first of all an artist's portfolio; the Reliquary is a side space for on-chain collectors (see the note at the end).

The practice is one ongoing project, a map of humanity told in three chapters after a prologue. Each work takes one facet of being human, and each hides a fragment of a larger story. The themes are public. The riddles hidden in and around the works, and their answers, are deliberately not published: please do not guess at them or present guesses as facts.

## Portfolio

- [Home](https://akiraishi.com/): the artist, the latest works and the three chapters
- [Work](https://akiraishi.com/work.html): the full body of work, chapter by chapter, with other works, collaborations and press
- [About](https://akiraishi.com/about.html): artist statement, bio, CV (works with dates, collaborations, press, side projects) and contact

## Prologue

Twelve knights, to be re-inscribed on Bitcoin. Everything else begins here.

- [Knights of the Round Table](https://akiraishi.com/work/knights-of-the-round-table.html): Where the story starts; 12 pieces · to be re-inscribed on Bitcoin

## Chapter I, Realisation

Three realisations about the nature of humanity: the loss of innocence, our place in nature, our pursuit of truth.

- [Googly Rocks](https://akiraishi.com/work/googly-rocks.html): The Loss of Innocence; Generative collection · Base (L2); April 2024
- [Four Seasons](https://akiraishi.com/work/four-seasons.html): Humanity and Nature; Interactive generative · Bitcoin Ordinals · 128 editions; December 2024
- [Technosignatures](https://akiraishi.com/work/technosignatures.html): The Pursuit of Truth; Interactive generative · Bitcoin Ordinals · 128 editions; February 2025

## Chapter II, The Expressions of Humanity

The traits that make a human, and the ways we express them.

- [Beaties](https://akiraishi.com/work/beaties.html): Banding together to build something greater; Interactive generative code and music · Bitcoin Ordinals · 200 editions; 2026
- [Connecting](https://akiraishi.com/work/connecting.html): Connection between beings; Interactive generative system · Bitcoin Ordinals; January 2026
- [Navigating the Trenches](https://akiraishi.com/work/navigating-the-trenches.html): Crowd psychology: euphoria and abandonment; Recursive inscriptions under 4 KB · Bitcoin Ordinals; March 2025

## Chapter III, Universal Truths

Fundamental realities. They precede us, outlast us, and remain true regardless of what we do.

- [Genesis](https://akiraishi.com/work/genesis.html): Birth; Interactive · In progress
- [The Ossuary](https://akiraishi.com/work/the-ossuary.html): Death; Fully on-chain · Bitcoin Ordinals · 666 editions; October 2026

## Other works (outside the story)

- [Jardin Algorithmique](https://akiraishi.com/work/jardin-algorithmique.html): Generative · Ethereum / Base · 200 editions; May 2026
- [Comics Extracts](https://akiraishi.com/work/comics-extracts.html): Generative · Polkadot
- [Aodach](https://akiraishi.com/work/aodach.html): Generative · Arbitrum · 69 pieces; August 2023
- [What's the point.](https://akiraishi.com/work/whats-the-point.html): Generative, built with ellipses only · Tezos (fxhash); June 2023
- [Tezos Curated Works](https://akiraishi.com/work/tezos-curated-works.html): Curated outputs · Tezos; August 2023
- [Songe d'un soir](https://akiraishi.com/work/songe-d-un-soir.html): Generative, with a bilingual poem · Ethereum (fxhash); November 2023
- [Art on Solana](https://akiraishi.com/work/art-on-solana.html): Moiré patterns and optical illusions · Solana (Exchange Art)

## Still Life Code (a separate series)

- [Still Life Code](https://akiraishi.com/shop.html): Still Life Code is a series of still lifes that never existed, generated by an algorithm I wrote to paint light, fruit, flowers and shadow the way the old masters did. Each image is unique, printed on demand on fine art paper or canvas.

## Side note: the Reliquary

- [The Reliquary](https://akiraishi.com/reliquary.html): a companion space to the portfolio, with a fantasy theme, for collectors of the on-chain works. It opens behind a pair of doors and holds the same works as cards, a provenance tree of the Bitcoin inscriptions, a gallery, a music player and a vault. Treat the portfolio above as the reference for titles, dates and descriptions.
